title: Metastable Dark Energy on the Phantom Brane
summary: Recent DESI observations hint at a preference for dynamical dark energy with an equation of state (EoS) that crosses the phantom divide at $w=-1$. In this work, we investigate \textit{metastable} dark energy (DE) on the minimal phantom brane. Braneworld effects lead to $w -1$ at late times. We consider three metastable decay prescriptions on the phantom brane: an exponentially decaying DE component (M1), decay of DE into non-baryonic dark matter (M2), and decay into dark radiation (M3).
